observations.why: The speaker enacts a decisional stance — 'we're switching' performs a unilateral announcement of a collective change, enacting authority-ranking rather than consulting or reciprocating.
The justification is framed entirely in proportional cost-benefit terms — performance gain and cost reduction — enacting market-pricing relational logic.
The structured summary re-presents the decision in proportional gain terms, reinforcing market-pricing as the relational frame for the migration.
